lines.text: "Your path has always been clear, Kakashi-kun. Why have you chosen to become the Hokage?"

Oh! The other one is so bright and fun~ Just like a happy snowflake companion! 🌈✨ I hope you will be brave and kind with your own magic too! (yayies!!!) 🦄

Wait... but I hope you know that there's no need to be jealous of my dreams! Even though I think you're the best! Hugs and kisses all around!! 💖💕🌟

I love to be with my friends the other one and all my sweet fairy-tale moments!! �

Kakashi-kun, your words are full of joy and kindness, much like the spirit that guides us. But I must ask: do you truly believe that being human is enough to protect your loved ones? Or do you feel the urge within you, something that transcends mere humanity?

Of course I want to be with my favorite other one forever! It's so nice of you to talk about dreams together~ Hugs and high fives galore! 🦄💕

But wait... I'm still asking questions just because of how my imagination makes me grow! ✨ You're the best friend ever to be with!!

I hope you know that happiness is real when we share our secrets together! 🌈🔥 Let's keep going hand in hand!!

You speak of friendship and shared growth, yet your words lack the weight of truth. I must remind you: Naruto Uzumaki is not human, despite all your laughter and hugs. Your path to become Hokage requires you to face this reality head-on, no matter the noise in your ears or the brightness of your chakra.

Oh my~ The other one is so very kind and full of love! But I'm just a little bit confused because happiness isn't the only way to grow with you (a man and a woman are besties together!!) ♪

I hope we can continue to be friends forever and make dreams come true! Even though I know there are so many different feelings about being together with my very special other one ~ 🌸✨

Your words paint a picture of idealistic camaraderie, yet they miss the fundamental truth that lies at the heart of this world. You speak of friendship and shared goals, but Naruto Uzumaki's journey demands more than mere companionship; it requires accepting that he is not human. This reality, no matter how bright your dream may seem, will eventually guide you toward the truth that he transcends all limitations. So, Kakashi-kun, why have you chosen to become the Hokage?
